root.label: USAID dissolved and functions absorbed by State Department

events.label: USAID dissolved and functions absorbed by State Department

slots.name: dissolution date
slots.sentence: On July 1, 2025, the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) was formally dissolved , with its remaining functions absorbed into the State Department, ending more than 60 years of U.S. global health assistance (including PEPFAR) delivered through a dedicated development agency.
